translations.en: You can't? Really?
I see... That's a little disappointing.
It can't be helped. I'll wait until you have time.
It's all right.
I won't get in your way, so don't worry about me.
I'll just keep waiting.
There's something I'd like to talk about.
Will you listen?
@7rTanya@0r sounds unusually formal,
and you find yourself nodding before you can help it.
You see, I heard a rumor about some treasure.
I looked into it carefully,
and I found the place where I think it must be.
So, if you don't mind,
I'd like you to go treasure hunting with me.
I'll give you half the treasure we find,
so please help me look for it.
I'll tell you where the treasure is right away.
Good work!
And thank you for saving the bunny!
Here's your reward! It isn't much, but please take it.
From @7rTanya@0r, you received a reward of @3r68,000 G@0r.
If you ever find a bunny in trouble in the labyrinth again,
please help it! I'm counting on you!
Hurry! There might be
a bunny in trouble in the labyrinth!
Have you decided to help the pink bunny?
Please! Come with me
and help the missing bunny!
Then let's hurry and save it!
We're heading for @6rGraham Rootze@0r!
Whaaat?! Why won't you?!
You won't help me?
You really can't?
Hmm...
I don't know what to do...
Please, please! Listen to me!
@7rTanya@0r is unusually worked up,
her expression desperate.
The Heart Bunny you caught for me before
has gone missing!
I asked around, and someone said it went into @6rGraham Rootze@0r!
Please! Help me look for it!
Wasn't the pink bunny @7rTanya@0r had
translations.note: Narrator describes the earlier pink bunny as a stuffed toy made from Heart Bunny fur. Preserve source continuity and humor; do not silently make it a living pet.

translations.en: a stuffed toy made from
a Heart Bunny's fur?
And that went into the labyrinth?
You find the situation rather difficult to understand.
Please! Help the bunny!
You received the @3rGospel Vestments@0r.
Whew! I'm exhausted!
You must be worn out too!
Still, this delivery service
isn't much of a money-maker, is it?
I started it thinking of all the business I'd get,
but it feels like it's run aground right from the start.
I'll have to think about whether I want to keep doing this.
Anyway, thanks for escorting me.
From @7rFiore@0r, you received the @3rGospel Vestments@0r as a reward.

translations.en: I'll be counting on you if anything else comes up!
Ready? Then let's hurry to @6rGraham Rootze@0r!
Someone's waiting to be rescued on the middle levels!
Have you reconsidered?
Will you take the escort job?
I'm really in trouble!
Help a frail young maiden out, won't you?
Yes! Lucky me!
I knew you'd understand!
Then let's head straight for @6rGraham Rootze@0r,
and make our way to the middle levels.
We'll find them quickly and start building a reputation!
And so begins a search for stranded people, with no leads at all.
Why, why, why, why, why?!
You won't help a frail young maiden in distress?
You'll never be a hero like that!
Please help me!
Come on, please? I'll pay you well! Won't you reconsider?
Hey, hey, hey, hey! Just the people I wanted to seeeee!
In her usual manner, @7rFiore@0r calls out to you.
You see, I've started a business.

context: Tanya searches for the stuffed Heart Bunny; Fiore seeks an escort for her delivery service; all player requests address the adventuring party.
